host_note: Host: Bacillus subtilis. Membrane predictions refer to a generic membrane context (cytoplasmic vs non-cytoplasmic side); no specific host membrane is assigned, and these are not viral-envelope predictions.
coordinate_convention: 1-based inclusive amino-acid positions in the annotated precursor translation
segment_encoding: comma-separated LABELstart-stop runs (1-based inclusive) covering every residue exactly once; expand to obtain the per-residue label string

state_definitions.I: inside / cytoplasmic side of the membrane (model-defined)
state_definitions.O: outside / non-cytoplasmic side (model-defined). In DeepTMHMM beta-barrel (BETA) predictions, O is the extracellular side of the outer membrane and P is the periplasm; alpha-helical models do not split periplasm from exterior
state_definitions.S: signal peptide (precursor numbering; predicted, cleavage not demonstrated)
